Summary
: English translation of the Gita-mahatmya. This book represents a conversation between Shiva and his consort Srimati Parvati. It is Lord Shiva’s glorification of the Bhagavad-gita.
Alternative spellings of this book include:
Bhagavad-gītā-māhātmya (भगवद्गीतामाहात्म्य)
